tVariables.tValue: Dark fantasy worlds collide as Guts brings his quest for vengeance tearing through Sanctuary. Earn Berserk themed cosmetics in the Event Reliquary and find even more incredible items to help you look the part in the Shop.
Elite enemies have a chance to drop a Behelit upon death.
Use your Behelits to claim rewards in the Berserk Event Reliquary. Look for it in the Events tab of the Reliquaries menu.
It’s Diablo IV’s second Anniversary. Thanks for being a part of the adventure! Celebrate with some festive new cosmetics in the Anniversary Event Reliquary.
Use gold to claim Anniversary Event rewards. Find gold dropping from slain foes, in containers throughout sanctuary, and as quest rewards. You can also get it by selling unwanted items to vendors.
Celebrate this milestone with new weapons, mount trophies, and mount armor cosmetics. Earn the mount armor by claiming all the other rewards in the Reliquary.
